description:
These scenarios drive LoanLens through tests/pages/self-healing/LegacyLocators.ts,
  whose locators were broken deliberately and left broken. Each fails in a
  different way: a renamed test id, changed button text, a label that became
  ambiguous, a positional locator that now finds the wrong element, and a
  removed feature.

  npm run test:self-healing   healing off: every scenario fails with a diagnosis
  npm run heal                healing on: validated fixes are used for this run only,
                              and a patch for each is written for review

  The test assertions are the same either way and come from the loan-book
  oracle, so a "healed" locator that finds the wrong element still fails.

elements.name: Renamed test id - the Total loans figure shows the size of the loan book

steps.name: the legacy Total loans figure should equal the number of loans in the loan book

elements.name: Changed button text - applying a status filter narrows the report

steps.name: I open the LoanLens loan book report
I filter the report to "Overdue" loans with the legacy Apply button
the report should list exactly the loans the loan book has for the current query

elements.name: Ambiguous label - the loan amount slider updates the number box

steps.name: I open the LoanLens EMI calculator
I set the loan amount to 5000000 with the legacy slider
the number boxes should show 5000000, 10 and 10

elements.name: Positional locator - the recent disbursements table starts with the newest loan

steps.name: the legacy recent disbursements table should start with the most recently disbursed loan

elements.name: Removed feature - exporting the report as CSV

steps.name: I open the LoanLens loan book report
